title: I created an exact copy of Tibia from scratch using the 2006 leak and ClaudeCode - Here are some players, positionned at their exact logout location, 2 decades ago.
author: lorty

comments.author: KeenAsGreen
comments.body:
What did you need claude for? 
The leak had everything...

replies.author: lorty
replies.body:
The leak had all the binary files on top of the client/data files, and it was a MMORPG, so you couldn't open the client and start a game out of nowhere. It's been converted into "open servers" ages ago, but it was a very long process (reverse engineering or copying mechanics) prior to AI.

So yeah, with Claude, I was able to convert the whole game into Godot in just a few days. This allowed me to upload the game to itch easily, ready to be played in offline mode.
